questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How women keep friendships going at work
Why older people feel lonely in big cities
Why many men find close friendships hard
How to organise a wedding with few friends
questions.why: They ask if it is true that men find it difficult to make friends, and hear from Max Dickins, who wrote a book on male friendship.

questions.q: How does Neil feel about his own friendships?
options: He has some close friends but wants more
He has more friends than he really needs
He has no close friends at all these days
He prefers to spend his free time alone
questions.why: Neil says he has some close friends, 'but maybe not as many as I'd like'.

questions.q: According to one survey, what share of British men say they have at least six close friends?
options: About half
Almost all of them
Around 72%
Only 27%
questions.why: Beth says only 27% of British men say they have at least six close friends.

questions.q: What idea does Claudia Hammond want to check?
options: That men make new friends faster than women do
That men hang out with anyone; women nurture friends
That friends are only really useful when life is easy
That people make most of their friends at school
questions.why: She mentions the idea that men hang out with whoever is around rather than nurture relationships, and asks if it's just a stereotype.

questions.q: What made Max Dickins realise he had a problem?
options: He had no close male friend to be his best man
His wife told him he seemed lonely and bored
He moved to a new city and knew nobody there
He read a survey about male friendship online
questions.why: When he was getting married, he realised he had no close male friends to ask to be his 'best man'.

questions.q: Why does Max say that loneliness 'shouldn't look like me'?
options: Because he is famous and has many fans
Because he is married now
Because he lives with his family
Because he is young, sociable and generous
questions.why: He says he's in his early to mid-30s, pretty outgoing and quick to buy his round.

questions.q: Why does Neil mention social media?
options: To say it is the best way for men to find new friends
To explain why older men feel so lonely nowadays
To say it makes others seem to have more fun
To show that men use it much less than women do
questions.why: He says social media can make it seem that everyone is having a great time with their mates, except you.

questions.q: What does Max suggest men do to make friends?
options: Spend more time with colleagues after work
Meet people at sports clubs or reading groups
Use online apps to find friends nearby
Stay in touch with their old school friends
questions.why: Max thinks the answer is meeting people in 'third spaces', such as sports clubs or reading groups.
